citations.claim: first controller_force_limit violation occurs at step 1 where controller applied 46.38 exceeding limit 40; cart position x shows step exists
cart velocity at violating step consistent with large unclipped force applied on step 1

explanation: Controller computed ~46.38 force on step 1 from initial v=0.5, theta=0.1, omega=0.3 and applied it without clipping to force_limit 40. Likely cause: state-feedback gains adapted to plant (heavy cart 2kg) produce large command, and clipping to force_limit is missing or applied after logging/check, so checker sees unclipped value.
vision_note: The cart stays near the center of the track and the pole remains nearly upright across steps 0 to 4. There is no visible fall, track exit, or abrupt motion, and no red violating body stands out.
